Teamwork Makes the Dream Work.

We believe in a happy, collaborative ambience and follow a culture that values differences in terms of views, ideas, and perspectives.

At KMG, Every Voice Matters!

The foundation upon which an organization is built is its beliefs and values. Key Management Group has built a history of success through the strong beliefs and values that its people have brought to the business effort.

We value people above everything else. We listen to our employees to create the right environment for diverse talent to succeed. We believe that people should be empowered; they should be given the support and encouragement to be creative and to stretch beyond the confines of their descriptions.

We are passionate about learning, and here at KMG, employees’ learning starts from day one. Here, we strive to truly work together to open our doors to new thinking and new ideas.

All of us want to be the best at what we do. And that’s what we keep in mind when we’re creating a place where people love to work—a place that allows people to bring their true selves to work.

Many of our people spend their entire lives working at Key Management Group. This is because we believe in creating an environment that is both stimulating and exciting. A culture where everyone can thrive!

Bridging Differences - Equality in the Workspace

“Gender diversity in the workplace is fundamental for a healthy work environment. Thus, Key Management Group Inc. strives to occlude the gender gap and promote diversity in their working environment. We have made diversity and equality our number one priority when it comes to talent acquisition. We drive innovation by adopting an inclusive culture that attracts a diverse group of the best and the brightest talents and inspires everyone to freely contribute to their maximum potential. Our mission is to create a deep-rooted impact on society through our actions.

The significance of women in the workplace is being highly acknowledged globally. Currently, KMG operates with about 25% women workforce and aims to increase it to 40% over the next two years. With the knowledge and skills that women are bringing to the table, it’s no wonder why companies like KMG are focused on promoting gender equality. At KMG, we allow our employees to flourish in an environment that encourages collaboration, equality, and diversity. The combination of inclusion, collaboration, opportunity, and high performance helps our professionals make a difference individually and collectively, making KMG one of the most rewarding places to work.

At KMG, we connect, grow and innovate. We believe in promoting a culture where all employees are respected equally and valued. We resolve a pay parity between men and women salaries and encourage equal employment opportunities for all qualified candidates regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, etc.”

Poornima Rampal
VP – Operations

Python Developer Gurgaon | Job Code #00006660

Experience: 6 - 8 Years

Role Overview 

We are hiring a Senior Python Developer to build and maintain the Python services in a P&C insurance policy administration platform. The platform is moving from a legacy DB2 and IBM i environment toward Python based backend code base, so the work spans maintaining and extending current Python logic against DB2 and building new Python services on the target platform. This is an offshore role delivered from India with a required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. 

 

Technical Skills 

  • 6 to 8 years of professional experience building and running production Python 3.x applications. 
  • Strong SQL and solid experience with relational databases, including query optimization and working with existing schemas.
  • Sound grasp of OOP, common design patterns, and asynchronous programming (asyncio). 
  • Experience building APIs or services with a modern Python framework such as FastAPI (Django or Flask acceptable). 
  • Automated testing discipline with PyTest or similar, and version control with Git in a collaborative workflow. 
  • Strong debugging, performance-tuning, and analytical skills, with the ability to work in unfamiliar legacy code. 

Essential Skills  

  • Good communication and documentation skills. 
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset. 
  • Team player with attention to detail. 
  • Available to work with 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. 

Desirable Skills 

  • Exposure to P&C insurance concepts such as policy, rating, lifecycle transactions, claims and billing. 
  • Prior experience delivering for US clients in an offshore or hybrid onshore-offshore model. 
  • Exposure to IBM i (AS/400) environments and to DB2 specifically, including reading and connecting to DB2 data. 
  • Data-processing experience with Pandas and NumPy. 
  • Familiarity with API security including OAuth2 and JWT. 

Educational Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Key Responsibilities  

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Python applications and services, including insurance business logic and scheduled data-processing jobs. 
  • Build and maintain Python APIs and services as part of the migration. 
  • Write SQL and work across the current DB2 data source including query tuning and data validation. 
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code with automated tests (unit, integration, functional) using PyTest or equivalent. 
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance bottlenecks in production systems. 
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Collaborate with US-based client stakeholders, architects, and the offshore delivery team, maintaining 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. 
  • Follow secure development practices across all work, with attention to client data isolation.
